summary: Public-API Metal 3 benchmark (compute/render/blit), GUI framebuffer/WindowServer presentation probe, repeat-test orchestrator, portable/native-x86 build tool and transactional staging/rollback for the designated physical GLK GPU. Original public-API tooling; no code is derived from upstream Linux/XNU sources.

authors.role: initial authoring of all device-lab sources, MSL workloads, oracle and tools

completion: x86_64-only portable/native-x86 build with Mach-O/signature metadata and reproducibility check; host gate (x86_64, untranslated, 15.8.1/24H32) and PCI 00:02.0/IOPCIBridge/OSData ownership checks; JSON-safe emit; process watchdogs; presentation confirmation; oracle digests and sanitizer canaries; orchestrator process-group watchdog and evidence validation; pure-sh transactional install/rollback with static safety scan; host test harness

target_identity.observed_state_note: Passive preflight shows NO IOAccelerator/Metal device (accelerator ioreg empty, hardware_or_metal_tested=false); the display is IONDRVFramebuffer only and a newly staged AuxKC requires a reboot. The tools therefore fail as unavailable (exit 3) on the target until a Metal 3 device bound to the physical GLK GPU exists.

toolchain_pins.host_test_variants: build-host architecture plain + AddressSanitizer builds, never staged
toolchain_pins.metallib_offline: NOT_RUN on this host (offline Metal toolchain absent); runtime MSL compilation on the target is the authoritative path

upstream_derivation.applicability: NOT APPLICABLE: the device-lab tools contain no Linux/XNU-derived source. They call only public Apple frameworks (Metal, AppKit, QuartzCore, IOKit, CryptoKit, Foundation), the C++ standard library and POSIX sh utilities.

boundaries: PUBLIC Metal/AppKit/IOKit success is NOT native-driver, fence, full-GPU-execution, WindowServer-scanout, or game-compatibility attestation; all such flags are kept false and the orchestrator rejects reports that set them.
The tools run only as an untranslated x86_64 process on macOS 15.8.1 (24H32); the host gate runs before any Metal/IOKit device or WindowServer call.

A Metal device counts only when its registryID resolves through IOService ancestors to an exact-class IOPCIDevice under an IOPCIBridge at 00:02.0 with the exact OSData IDs and reg/assigned-addresses; IORegistryCompatibility / synthetic metadata is rejected.
No Metal device, a Rosetta-translated process, or a missing Metal 3 family is a FAILING/UNAVAILABLE result, never a passing skip and never a CPU fallback.
Drawable-texture readback proves GPU-produced presented pixels; photon/scanout verification needs Screen Recording (TCC) permission and is NOT_RUN by design (no TCC change).

Staging never deploys; install/rollback is a separate reviewed step on the target, guarded by machine/OS/PCI fingerprint and restricted to a validated non-system install root with verified byte backups.
adaptation: Claude authored all device-lab source, the MSL workloads, the oracle cross-checks, the build/orchestrate/staging tools and the host integration tests. Builds and host CPU-only tests ran on a build-only Apple-silicon developer Mac; x86_64 artifacts were exercised there only under Rosetta in CPU-only modes or up to the host gate. Metal/GPU/GUI paths were compiled but intentionally NOT executed (no developer-Mac GPU execution) and are for the operator to run on the physical target.
execution: HOST build + CPU-only self/integration tests only
